prior_exposure.impact: June-July 2026 labels and metrics were inspected before the requested direction protocol was frozen. Any later June-July result is not an untouched independent test. The earlier run had a different close-to-close regression target and split.

The first direction implementation generated test predictions for every validation-grid candidate before selecting the model. It did not use test labels for selection, but violated the requested test-once procedure. V2 is preserved as superseded; V3 fixes the code and re-runs, and the interval remains contaminated.

Prior NVIDIA August 2026 and CoreWeave/CPI November 2026 development cards exist locally. They are excluded from this run's retrieval, feature input and model context. The same prior manifest also contains a May 2026 NVIDIA comparison release, but it is not supplied to the historical model.
